releaseNotes: YancoTV 1.6.1 — patch on 1.6.0. Recording now works reliably, silent settings-loss is fixed, and the app no longer rebuilds its whole catalogue on every launch. New: phone swipe controls, guide row-height options, in-app licences & privacy. This patch also keeps scheduled recordings armed across app updates. Known issue: on a TV remote you can't yet skip across a long programme block in the guide — touch works. Best tried on a phone.
